workload.identity: PR81A deterministic corpus (15 PDFs/27 pages) via seed_workspace: ingest+publish -> doc-rev-01 v3->v4 revision+republish -> publication-pin GC lifecycle -> PR80A-style review scenario; cold-start samples on fresh databases

windows.label: seed the corpus docs + build generation + publish lexical

database_rows.source: exact per-table SELECT COUNT(*) via readonly sqlite connection, summed and categorized by table-name prefix

wal_write_amplification.reason: SQLite runs in rollback-journal mode on this profile (journal_mode=delete); there is no write-ahead log to amplify. WAL-mode amplification is an industrial-profile dimension (pr87b-industrial-economics-envelope.json).

retained_generations.source: kernel_generations grouped by state after pin-held GC and pin-released GC

fts_storage.reason: this SQLite build does not expose the DBSTAT virtual table, so physical FTS5 shadow-table bytes cannot be attributed; logical volume is measured in counters (lexical rows + text characters)

vector_storage.reason: no vector store implementation exists on any profile; the publication schema reserves a nullable vector_generation_id slot only

visual_storage.reason: this workload runs with visual capability absent (no render store, no visual index); visual storage is measured by the OFF/ON visual economics artifact on the same corpus

copy_bytes.source: LocalPayloadStore staging writes + verification read-backs + source store staged artifact bytes

cold_start.source: fresh SQLite database per sample: migrate -> seed the corpus -> build generation -> publish lexical -> first lexical_search query answered

reprocessing.source: doc-rev-01 v3->v4 content revision through the real commit/generation/publication path

review_burden.source: deterministic conflicting-candidate invoice extraction through the real extraction service; review-required runs + fields counted, one review decision applied and its kernel rows counted

logical_source_bytes.source: corpus manifest byte_length of committed PDF artifacts

sqlite_wal_bytes.source: kernel.db-wal file size (absent under rollback-journal mode)

database_bytes.source: PRAGMA page_count * page_size on the workload database

ingest_publish_wall_ms.source: perf_counter around seed_workspace (corpus docs + generation + publication)

non_claims: no human review time is claimed; review burden is item/row counts only
no queue dwell time is claimed; no timed review queue is driven
physical FTS byte attribution is unavailable on SQLite builds without DBSTAT
visual-derived storage is not exercised here; the OFF/ON visual economics artifact (pr87c-visual-economics.json) measures the same corpus with visual enabled
